verdict.rationale: Docs and a runtime probe show granular install: `$skill-installer <name>` installs individual named skills (e.g. linear, gh-address-comments), and a real keyless install (`npx skills add openai/plugins --skill plugin-creator`) pulls just one skill from a multi-skill repo/marketplace rather than the whole bundle. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of selective install for the plugin marketplace (not just skills), and no evidence of dependency/version conflicts when mixing selective installs.
